content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To get in a car, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Locate the car keys on the kitchen counter (30 seconds)
Step 2. Check that the house windows are closed (2 minutes)
Step 3. Walk from the front porch to the driveway (20 seconds)
Step 4. Pull the car door handle firmly (2 seconds)
Step 5. Adjust the side mirrors (45 seconds)
Step 6. Press the unlock button on the key fob (1 second)
Step 7. Stand directly next to the driver-side door (5 seconds)
Step 8. Position your hand on the door grip (2 seconds)
Step 9. Swing the car door open wide (3 seconds)
Step 10. Check the driveway for any obstacles (15 seconds)
Step 11. Step out of the front door (5 seconds)
Step 12. Confirm the car lights flash to indicate unlocking (1 second)
Step 13. Lift your left foot toward the door sill (2 seconds)
Step 14. Approach the vehicle's left side (10 seconds)
Step 15. Glance at the car's exterior for scratches (30 seconds)
Step 16. Reach out toward the handle (2 seconds)
Step 17. Step off the porch stairs (5 seconds)
Step 18. Close and lock the front door of the house (10 seconds)
Step 19. Walk across the front lawn (15 seconds)
Step 20. Place your phone in the center console (5 seconds)
Step 21. Sit down on the driver's seat (3 seconds)
Step 22. Inspect the tires for proper inflation (1 minute)
Step 23. Adjust the headrest height (10 seconds)
Step 24. Plug in the phone charger (5 seconds)
Step 25. Check the mail in the mailbox near the car (1 minute)
Step 26. Walk around the rear of the vehicle (15 seconds)
Step 27. Tuck your coat tail under you (3 seconds)
Step 28. Slide your torso into the cabin (2 seconds)
Step 29. Lower your center of gravity to enter (2 seconds)
Step 30. Clear the seat of any loose debris (10 seconds)
Step 31. Verify the door is fully unlatched (2 seconds)
Step 32. Walk down the paved walkway (12 seconds)
Step 33. Grip the top of the door frame (2 seconds)
Step 34. Fasten the seatbelt (5 seconds)
Step 35. Put your hands on the steering wheel (2 seconds)
Step 36. Pick up your sunglasses (10 seconds)
Step 37. Walk toward the driver's side (8 seconds)
Step 38. Take a deep breath of fresh air (3 seconds)
Step 39. Shake off any rain from your jacket (5 seconds)
Step 40. Look at the sky to check the weather (5 seconds)
Step 41. Navigate around a puddle (4 seconds)
Step 42. Check that the path to the seat is clear (2 seconds)
Step 43. Position your body to face away from the car (3 seconds)
Step 44. Move into the door's opening radius (4 seconds)
Step 45. Stop walking once at the door (2 seconds)
Step 46. Reach for the door frame for balance (2 seconds)
Step 47. Duck your head to clear the roofline (2 seconds)
Step 48. Check your pocket for your wallet (5 seconds)
Step 49. Extend your arm to the door edge (2 seconds)
Step 50. Turn your body toward the interior (2 seconds)
Step 51. Place your right foot on the floor mat (2 seconds)
Step 52. Pivot on your heel (2 seconds)
Step 53. Lift your right leg into the footwell (2 seconds)
Step 54. Verify the door seal is clear (5 seconds)
Step 55. Check the overhead sun visor (5 seconds)
Step 56. Release the tension on the door hinges (1 second)
Step 57. Scan the ground for ice (10 seconds)
Step 58. Adjust your grip on your bag (5 seconds)
Step 59. Put on your driving gloves (45 seconds)
Step 60. Double-check that you have your phone (5 seconds)
